name: Maximum Intensity Projection (MIP)
aliases: Direct Volume Ray Casting with Max Intensity Projection
definition: A shader class for Maximum Intensity Projection, though the provided code only sets up uniforms and does not implement the MIP logic in the visible fragment shader. It is instantiated but not used in the main rendering loop shown (firstHitShader is used).
summary: Maximum Intensity Projection is a volume rendering technique that projects the highest scalar value along each viewing ray, highlighting bright structures for fast overviews unlike alpha blending.
